CONCEPT: the stiffness made visible as a glowing knot. Photorealistic cinematic photograph. A dim early-morning Japanese bedroom (bed with rumpled white bedding, bedside lamp glowing warm, wooden nightstand, curtains with gray dawn light). A Japanese man in his late 50s with gray hair, wearing a gray T-shirt and dark pajama pants, is half-risen from the bed, bent forward with one fist pressed into the mattress and his head lowered, wincing. Wrapped tightly around his waist and lower spine, over the T-shirt, are thick dark-red glowing ropes knotted like a giant clenched fist, with a few rope ends trailing onto the bed; the shirt fabric bunches under the knots and the knots glow a dull hot red like embers, as if the stiffness in his back had become a visible thing. Surreal but not gory: no blood, no wounds, no flesh. Shallow depth, dramatic warm-and-cold light, hyper-detailed.
TEXT, lower left: a royal-blue rounded rectangle containing white bold text in two lines: 「朝、腰が伸びない。」「その正体は『筋肉の酸欠』」 . Directly under the box, white regular text with soft shadow, two lines: 「腰の奥で固まった筋肉が、」「血を止めています。」 . Lower right, small white pill outline with text: 「湿布では届かない場所」

st09_tegaki:
A static ad image, 4:5 portrait (1080x1350): a realistic phone snapshot with handwriting on the subject, the kind of photo a real person posts. A Japanese woman in her mid-50s seen from behind, sitting on the edge of a futon in a small Japanese bedroom, her floral pajama top lifted at the back to show her lower back with two large white rectangular pain-relief patches side by side. Written directly on the patches in thick black marker, slightly messy natural Japanese handwriting: on the left patch two lines 「毎晩」「貼ってる」 , on the right patch two lines 「朝は」「まだ痛い」 . Her hand reaches back holding the marker. Shot from behind at close range by her husband. Background: wrinkled bedding, a low chest of drawers, a laundry basket, cropped at the edges. Light: warm ceiling light only, a bit dim. No other text anywhere.
PHOTO STYLE: Shot on an iPhone 15 Pro main camera (24mm equivalent), handheld, vertical 4:5. Ordinary unedited camera-roll photo taken by a family member, not a professional. Deep focus: background stays mostly sharp, no creamy bokeh, no portrait mode. Smartphone Smart HDR look with limited dynamic range: window or lamp highlights slightly blown, shadows a little noisy, fine luminance noise in dark areas, mild JPEG sharpening. Uneven mixed lighting with a slight white-balance cast. Slightly off-center, slightly tilted framing, something cropped at the frame edge. Real Japanese person with ordinary looks (not a model): visible pores, fine lines, slight facial asymmetry, uneven skin tone, under-eye shadows, a few flyaway hairs, no makeup retouching. Lived-in Japanese home with everyday clutter. Clothing has real wrinkles and pilling.
